text:
mia: kicking off midnight feature flag run for `llmroute_v3_enable`. change window 00:00-02:00 UTC. plan: 1% canary in eu-west-1 -> wait 15m -> 10% -> wait 30m -> 50% -> wait 45m -> 100%. hold at each step until telemetry OK. model pinned to model-route v3.0.2 for the entire window. @deploybot schedule please, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack scheduled. steps enqueued: 00:00 canary 1%, 00:15 step check, 00:20 ramp 10%, 00:50 ramp 50%, 01:35 final 100%. will publish step completions and snapshots.

ben: propose rollback criteria: sustained CPU > 70% for 5m OR p95 latency > 450ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.5% (5m). add traffic amplification if token-queue-length spikes > 3x baseline.

olivia: also add semantic quality gate: eval loss / prompt-eval drift > 2% on our nightly smoke prompts => immediate rollback. include a quick eval run after canary.

sam: good. on rollback we should fast-pin to v2.0.9 and disable routing FF cohort. runbook: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-ff (see "fast pinback"). who will trigger manual pin if needed?

mia: @sre-oncall to execute manual if auto conditions ambiguous. deploybot will auto-run the rollback command if triggers met.

deploybot: rollback action configured: pin model-route to v2.0.9 + set `llmroute_v3_enable=off` for all cohorts. auto-rollback command (ops):
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_enable --pin-version v2.0.9 --reason "auto-rollback: telemetry"
```

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll mute noisy alerts and monitor p95, error-rate, cpu, and model-token-queue-length. will post immediate action if thresholds cross.

deploybot: canary 1% executed at 00:00 UTC. publishing metrics snapshot in ~10m.

ben: if canary stable by 00:15, do 10% at 00:20 and 50% at 00:50. enforce quiet-window: no other routing or model deploys during 00:00-02:00. :thumbsup:

olivia: prepping short release note: customers in eu-west will see routing changes; fallback guaranteed. adding rollback blurb and contact for SRE.

mia: attaching quick pre-canary eval: running prompt set A through v3.0.2 vs v2.0.9 now, results expected in 5m.

deploybot: metrics snapshot (00:10): p95 320ms, error-rate 0.12%, cpu 48%, token-queue-length 1.0x baseline. preliminary pass. holding until full 15m.

sre-oncall: looks clean so far. i'll keep watch and be ready to hit rollback if any gate fails.

mia: thanks all — will monitor slack thread and escalate if anything weird shows up.
